This berries is found chiefly in frigid climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in north-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

Telek berries have two distinct uses. Swallowed, they restore 3–30 concussion hits lost to cold. Crushed and rubbed onto frostbite, they can remove the injury in about ten rounds. Juice pressed from the berries keeps for approximately a month, allowing a small supply to be prepared for winter travel.
